key_insight: The paper proves that the planar five-body problem has only finitely many central configurations for every choice of positive masses, fully resolving Smale’s sixth problem for five bodies in the plane.
engineering_relevance: This result strengthens the mathematical foundations of multi-agent and gravitational N-body modeling by guaranteeing that the equilibrium configuration set is finite, making exhaustive classification and symbolic verification feasible.
method: Extend Albouy–Kaloshin’s algebraic-geometry approach to five bodies
Analyze valuations at infinity for hypothetical solution curves
Use computer algebra and exact rational certificates to eliminate all remaining mass cases
evidence_signal: The authors combine theoretical elimination with exact computer-algebra certificates and also report explicit counts of real central configurations on two special mass rays: 306 and 294 up to orientation-preserving similarity.
watch_item: The proof relies on intricate case analysis and special handling of a few mass families, so reproducing the argument depends on the provided certificates, programs, and Lean formalization.
paper_title: Finiteness of planar central configurations of five bodies for all positive masses
